title: AI-Brains claude-hook payload
description: JSON payload passed to `ai-brains claude-hook --payload`. Live path ingests `prompt` (UserPromptSubmit) and/or `lastAssistantMessage` (Stop / SessionEnd) after T234 message-only filter. Does not parse transcript_path. Mid-payload garbage (invalid JSON) exits 1 with JSON; unrecognized / Grok-shaped stdin exits 0 with no ingest.

sessionId.description: Claude session id (UUID preferred). Used for delta-sync and turn-id namespace.

projectHash.description: Normalized cwd path or `claude-unbound` when unbound. Alias key via ai-brains-path.

prompt.description: UserPromptSubmit prompt text. Empty/whitespace skips the user role (exit 0).

lastAssistantMessage.description: Stop / SessionEnd last assistant text. Empty/whitespace skips the assistant role (exit 0). Live SOOT — do not wait on transcript_path.

cwd.description: Optional working directory; used for projectHash when the wrapper did not set it.

turnId.description: Optional stable turn id from the vendor payload.

uuid.description: Optional Claude record uuid; preferred in live turn-id `{event}:{uuid}`.
